observations: Photos show a white IBC (intermediate bulk container) with a metal cage and a bottom outlet valve area.
Photo 1 shows a label area on the tank front; text overlay includes “POSTED ON JJU” and “BONIFACE OVILINK”.
Photo 2 shows partial molded/printed markings on the tank (appears like capacity/serial text but not fully readable).
No clear brand/model plate, no visible certification/UN marking clearly readable, and no close-up of the outlet/valve condition.

claims.claim: To store industrial liquids or hazardous chemicals
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photos do not clearly show UN/DOT/ISO certification markings or hazard-compatibility documentation.

risks.risk: Whether this IBC is actually certified/approved for hazardous chemicals (UN/DOT/ISO markings not clearly visible).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the tank’s certification/UN marking plate/stamp (and any manufacturer label) plus the cage label if present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a general-purpose used IBC (not confirmed hazardous/chemical-approved).

risks.risk: Leak risk / valve outlet condition (photos don’t show the outlet valve, bung/cap, or any leak testing).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the bottom outlet valve and piping/hoses, plus a short video showing the valve closed and no seepage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing inspection/possible reseal (worst case: treat as not guaranteed leak-free).

risks.risk: Tank integrity (cracks, bulges, or repairs) not fully checkable from these angles.
risks.proof: Full 360° photos of the tank body (top, sides, bottom corners) and the cage welds/feet.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with unknown condition (worst case: assume wear/damage possible).

risks.risk: Capacity/size uncertainty (markings are not fully readable).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the molded capacity marking (e.g., 1000L) and any manufacturer spec label.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest likely value for an IBC size category until capacity is confirmed.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the manufacturer label and any UN/DOT/ISO certification markings on the tank (and cage if separate).
Close-up photos of the bottom outlet valve area (and any caps/bungs) plus a short video of the valve being operated and held closed without seepage.
Full 360° condition photos: top dome, all sides, bottom corners, and cage welds/feet.
A readable photo of the capacity/serial/spec markings on the tank.
response.reason: It appears to be a used IBC for liquids, but the key factors that determine safe use and resale value in Rivers (hazard certification, leak-free valve/outlet condition, and exact capacity) are not verifiable from the provided photos.
